name: lift_rank_le_of_injective_injective
statement: R' →+* R) (j : S →+* S') (hi : Injective i) (hj : Injective j) (hc : (j.comp (algebraMap R S)).comp i = algebraMap R' S') : lift.{v'} (Module.rank R S) ≤ lift.{v} (Module.rank R' S')

name: lift_rank_le_of_surjective_injective
statement: R →+* R') (j : S →+* S') (hi : Surjective i) (hj : Injective j) (hc : (algebraMap R' S').comp i = j.comp (algebraMap R S)) : lift.{v'} (Module.rank R S) ≤ lift.{v} (Module.rank R' S')

name: lift_rank_eq_of_equiv_equiv

name: lift_rank_map_le
statement: M →ₗ[R] M') (p : Submodule R M) : Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank R (p.map f)) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v'} (Module.rank R p)
